packages.title: Maldives Ultimate Overwater Retreat
packages.short_description: Surrender to absolute island luxury with private dining, dolphin cruises, and overwater spa treatments.
packages.description:
Experience the absolute peak of tropical luxury. Located in the pristine Baa Atoll, a UNESCO biosphere reserve, your residence is an architectural masterpiece suspended over an emerald lagoon.

With a private slide plunging straight into the ocean, a retractable roof for stargazing from bed, and a personal chef on call, this is not just a holiday—it is a bespoke sanctuary created around your exact desires.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paradise
itinerary.description: Touch down at Velana International Airport (Male) where your personal representative welcomes you and escorts you to your private luxury yacht. Enjoy fresh coconuts and gourmet canapés as you cruise towards the Baa Atoll. Check into your massive overwater residence, meet your personal butler, and enjoy a curated sunset welcome dinner on your private deck.

itinerary.title: Overwater Spa & Sunset Dolphin Cruise
itinerary.description: Awake to a floating breakfast in your private infinity pool. Spend the morning relaxing before a 90-minute couples massage in a glass-bottomed overwater spa pavilion. In the late afternoon, embark on a private double-decker yacht for a sunset dolphin-watching cruise, accompanied by premium champagne and sashimi prepared on board.

itinerary.title: Manta Ray Snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay
itinerary.description: Board a speed-craft with a marine biologist and head to Hanifaru Bay, one of the world's most famous aggregation sites for manta rays and whale sharks. Swim alongside these majestic giants in crystal-clear waters. Return to the resort for a beachside wood-fired pizza lunch and a free afternoon to enjoy the water slide.

itinerary.title: Castaway Sandbank Picnic
itinerary.description: Your butler escorts you to a completely private, deserted sandbank where a luxury canopy has been set up. Spend the afternoon snorkeling, swimming, or sunbathing in total isolation. A private chef prepares a bespoke barbecue lunch featuring fresh local lobster, Wagyu beef, and exotic tropical fruits.

itinerary.title: Deep Ocean Gastronomy
itinerary.description: Relax on your deck or enjoy stand-up paddleboarding. In the evening, descend five meters below the sea surface for a farewell dinner at a world-class glass-domed underwater restaurant. Indulge in a 6-course tasting menu paired with fine vintage wines while coral reefs and colorful marine life glide overhead.

itinerary.title: Departure via Private Seaplane
itinerary.description: Savor one final sunrise yoga session followed by breakfast. Bid farewell to your butler and board a private seaplane charter. Enjoy a scenic flight over the islands before connecting to your international flight at Male.

inclusions.title: All private yacht and seaplane transfers
5 nights in an Ultra Luxury Overwater Residence
Daily chef-curated breakfast, lunch, and specialty dinners
Unlimited access to overwater spa treatments & yoga
Personal butler and private marine biologist guide

exclusions.title: Vintage cellar selection champagnes (house brands included)

faqs.question: Is the seaplane transfer private?
faqs.answer: Yes, we arrange private seaplane charters to ensure maximum privacy, safety, and direct scheduling aligned with your international arrival time.

faqs.question: Can the menu be tailored to dietary requirements?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Your personal butler will contact you before departure to gather all food preferences and allergies, and your private chef will tailor all meals accordingly.

testimonials.title: Pure Heaven on Earth
testimonials.review: The overwater villa was beyond words. Having a private chef make breakfast on our deck while watching baby reef sharks swim by was an unforgettable highlight. Worth every single penny.

packages.title: Alpine Elegance & Zermatt Luxury
packages.short_description: A majestic winter journey through the peak of Switzerland's luxury hospitality under the Matterhorn.
packages.description:
Experience the Swiss Alps in unmatched grandeur. Nestled in the car-free mountain village of Zermatt, your chalet is a masterpiece of alpine design, combining rustic timber with modern glass facades facing the Matterhorn.

Enjoy private heli-skiing, Michelin-starred gastronomy, and private thermal baths high above the clouds.

itinerary.title: Swiss Arrival & Glacier Express
itinerary.description: Land in Zurich or Geneva and board a first-class panoramic train journey or helicopter transfer straight into the car-free village of Zermatt. Check into your designer mountain chalet and enjoy a custom welcome reception featuring Swiss chocolate and vintage local wines.

itinerary.title: First Tracks with Ski Master
itinerary.description: Grip the snow early. A private ski instructor guides you through Zermatt's massive ski area, extending into Cervinia, Italy. Stop for a slopeside lunch at a historic mountainside tavern serving upscale regional cuisine.

itinerary.title: Heli-Skiing & Champagne Toast
itinerary.description: Embark on an adrenaline-filled heli-skiing trip to Monte Rosa. Guided by an expert, carve fresh tracks down untouched powder fields. Break on a glacier peak for a champagne toast with spectacular views of the Matterhorn.

itinerary.title: Thermal Baths & Wellness Day
itinerary.description: Soothe your muscles. Spend the day in a private thermal spa featuring outdoor heated pools overlooking snow-clad peaks, steam caves, and custom aromatherapy massages.

itinerary.title: Cheese & Sommelier Wine Pairing
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxed morning exploring Zermatt's shops. In the evening, enjoy a private cheese fondue and wine masterclass in your chalet led by a master sommelier, sampling rare alpine vintages.

itinerary.title: Matterhorn Culinary Finale
itinerary.description: Take a scenic cable car to the Matterhorn Glacier Paradise. In the evening, celebrate your final night with a Michelin-starred gourmet dining experience, highlighting modern alpine gastronomy.

itinerary.title: Farewell Alps
itinerary.description: Savor a final Swiss breakfast before checking out. Board a luxury private transfer or first-class train back to the airport for your flight home.

inclusions.title: 6 nights in a Luxury Chalet Suite with Matterhorn views
Private ski instructor & premium rental equipment
All meals described in the itinerary
Private heli-skiing excursion to Monte Rosa
Daily access to private thermal spa facilities & treatments

exclusions.title: Ski pass cards (available for purchase at check-in)

faqs.question: Is this package suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, we tailor ski routes and private instruction to all levels, from absolute beginners to expert skiers.

testimonials.title: Incredible Alpine Experience
testimonials.review: Everything from the train transfer to the helicopter glacier tour was planned to perfection. The chalet was a dream and the food was Michelin-grade.
